title: Transcript (W3C Verifiable Credential)
description: W3C Verifiable Credentials Data Model 2.0 representation of an OpenCerts transcript, for use with the TrustVC (@trustvc/trustvc) library.

issuer.description: W3C VC issuer: a URI/DID string, or an object describing the issuing organisation. Replaces the OpenAttestation "issuers" array. The W3C VC v2 context marks "issuer" as @protected, so context.json declares these as top-level terms rather than scoping them under "issuer".

id.description: DID or URL identifying the issuer; replaces the OpenAttestation issuer "did"
identifier of the recipient (DID/URL), when known

type.description: the credential subject type; must be (or include) "Transcript", because context.json defines the transcript terms inside that type-scoped @context

graduationDate.description: The date that this student graduated from the course

attainmentDate.description: The date that this qualification was awarded to the recipient

recipient.description: information about the person that is receiving the transcript

qualificationLevel.description: This is an array of objects used to attach descriptors from frameworks such as Singapore's SSEC-EQA or the internationally recognised ISCED. Multiple instances are allowed to indicate either equivalents or to indicate a multi-level qualifications

fieldOfStudy.description: This is an array of objects used to attach descriptors from frameworks such as Singapore's SSEC-FOS or the internationally recognised ISCED-F. Multiple instances are allowed to indicate either equivalents or to indicate a multi-field qualification such as double degrees

frameworkName.description: Prepend the actual framework name with the scope of the framework

languageMedium.description: Language that the course was undertaken in

skills.description: Information about skills that the recipient learnt

frameworkUri.description: URI where to find the details about the framework

sector.description: The industry/sector for which this framework is meant for

category.description: Skills and competency category. (Technical Skills Competency (TSC) or Critical Core Skills (CCS)

competencyCode.description: Skills and competency code from Skills Framework

competencyDescription.description: Detailed description of the skill or competency
examples: Monitor aircraft systems, performance and external environments as well as comply with Air Traffic Control (ATC) instructions and en route navigation requirements to ensure safe and optimal flight conditions

competencyLevel.description: Level of competency / skills: TSC Pro Level (numeric from 1 onward), GSC Pro Level (Critical Core Skills - basic, intermediate, advanced)

competencyLevelDescription.description: Narrative information for this competency level
examples: Analyse aircraft performance through close monitoring of flight decks to ensure optimal flight conditions during cruise

@context.description: JSON-LD contexts. The first entry must be the W3C VC v2.0 context.

id.description: credential identifier. GENERATED, not supplied: TrustVC mints a urn:uuid at signing time and rejects a document that already carries an "id". It is therefore only valid on a signed credential (one that has a "proof"), which the conditional below enforces.

validFrom.description: the date and time from which the credential is valid (replaces issuedOn)

validUntil.description: the date and time after which the credential is no longer valid (replaces expiresOn)

credentialStatus.description: Bitstring Status List entry (W3C VC Data Model 2.0), used to revoke or suspend the credential. All four of type/statusPurpose/statusListIndex/statusListCredential are needed — a partial entry is rejected at signing time.

statusListIndex.description: position of this credential's bit in the status list; a non-negative integer, expressed as a string per the Bitstring Status List spec

statusListCredential.description: absolute URL of the status list credential

renderMethod.description: How a viewer should render the credential. Replaces the OpenAttestation "$template": url -> id, type -> type, name -> templateName.

id.description: URL of a decentralised renderer to render this document

templateName.description: Template name to be used by the template renderer to determine the template to use

then.$comment: An unsigned credential must not carry an "id": TrustVC generates it while signing and refuses any document that already has one.
